jp: 調査隊のこと？
jp_grezzo: "調査隊のこと？"
en: You mean the research team?
en_grezzo: "You mean the research team?"
it: Il gruppo di ricerca?

jp: きっと気のせいだ
jp_grezzo: "きっと気のせいだ"
en: It's probably your imagination.
en_grezzo: "It's probably your imagination."
it: Sarà una tua impressione

jp: 何か…頼み事があったような気がするけど思い出せない…。
jp_grezzo: "何か…頼み事があったような気がするけど思い出せない…。"
en: I think I asked you for something earlier, but I can't remember what...
en_grezzo: "I think I asked you for something earlier, but I can't remember what..."
it: Mi sa che... ti avevo chiesto qualcosa, ma non me lo ricordo...

jp: そういえば…調査隊なのになんで俺一人なんだ！？おかしいだろ。確かに仲間はいたはずだ…。
jp_grezzo: "そういえば…調査隊なのになんで俺一人なんだ！？おかしいだろ。確かに仲間はいたはずだ…。"
en: Now that you mention it... why would you call it a research \"team\" if I'm the only person in it?! That's strange. I'm pretty sure I had some company...
en_grezzo: "Now that you mention it... why would you call it a research \"team\" if I'm the only person in it?! That's strange. I'm pretty sure I had some company..."
it: Adesso che ci penso... si chiama gruppo di ricerca, e allora perché sono da solo?! Non torna. Dei compagni li avevo di sicuro...

jp: 駄目だ！存在はぼんやりと思い出せるけど、名前も人数も思い出せない！みんな同じ格好だったから…いや、隊長はなんか紫っぽい格好をしていた気がするな…。
jp_grezzo: "駄目だ！存在はぼんやりと思い出せるけど、名前も人数も思い出せない！みんな同じ格好だったから…いや、隊長はなんか紫っぽい格好をしていた気がするな…。"
en: I can't remember! I can vaguely recall their existence, but I can't remember their names or how many there were! They were all dressed the same... no, I think the captain was dressed in something purple...
en_grezzo: "I can't remember! I can vaguely recall their existence, but I can't remember their names or how many there were! They were all dressed the same... no, I think the captain was dressed in something purple..."
it: Niente da fare! Che c'erano me lo ricordo, ma come in una nebbia: né i nomi né quanti fossero! Erano tutti vestiti uguale... no, il capo mi pare avesse addosso qualcosa sul viola...

jp: クソ、なんでこんな中途半端な忘れ方なんだ？？あの獣にただ喰われただけなら、もっと綺麗に忘れているはずなのに。
jp_grezzo: "クソ、なんでこんな中途半端な忘れ方なんだ？？あの獣にただ喰われただけなら、もっと綺麗に忘れているはずなのに。"
en: Damn it, why do I have to forget in such a half-hearted way? If I'd just been devoured by that beast, I would have been able to forget them completely.
en_grezzo: "Damn it, why do I have to forget in such a half-hearted way? If I'd just been devoured by that beast, I would have been able to forget them completely."
it: Merda, perché li dimentico così a metà?? Se quella bestia se li fosse solo mangiati, li avrei dimenticati puliti.

jp: 思い出せ…そうだ。俺たちは元々、エーテルの風が谷の生態系にどんな影響を与えているかを調査しにきていた。だけどある日を境に、故郷のことがだんだん思い出せなくなっていって。
jp_grezzo: "思い出せ…そうだ。俺たちは元々、エーテルの風が谷の生態系にどんな影響を与えているかを調査しにきていた。だけどある日を境に、故郷のことがだんだん思い出せなくなっていって。"
en: Let me try to remember... yes, that's right. We were originally here to investigate how the Etherwind was affecting the ecosystem of the valley. But one day, I started to have trouble remembering my hometown.
en_grezzo: "Let me try to remember... yes, that's right. We were originally here to investigate how the Etherwind was affecting the ecosystem of the valley. But one day, I started to have trouble remembering my hometown."
it: Ricorda... ecco. Noi eravamo venuti qui per studiare che effetti avesse il vento d'etere sull'ecosistema della valle. Poi da un certo giorno in poi ho cominciato a non ricordarmi più il mio paese.

jp: ただ事じゃないってアイツが…誰だっけ？とにかく騒ぎになって。そうこうしているうちに谷に記憶を喰らう獣が現れたって聞いて。この街の住民のことも思い出せなくなってきて…。
jp_grezzo: "ただ事じゃないってアイツが…誰だっけ？とにかく騒ぎになって。そうこうしているうちに谷に記憶を喰らう獣が現れたって聞いて。この街の住民のことも思い出せなくなってきて…。"
en: Somebody had made a huge fuss about it to me, saying it was no laughing matter... who was it? Anyway, in the meantime I'd heard that a memory-eating beast had appeared in the valley. I couldn't even remember the people who lived in this town...
en_grezzo: "Somebody had made a huge fuss about it to me, saying it was no laughing matter... who was it? Anyway, in the meantime I'd heard that a memory-eating beast had appeared in the valley. I couldn't even remember the people who lived in this town..."
it: Quello lì diceva che non era una cosa normale... come si chiamava? Insomma, è nato un putiferio. E intanto arriva la voce che nella valle era comparsa una bestia che mangia i ricordi. E ho cominciato a non ricordarmi nemmeno la gente di questa città...

jp: それから…。
jp_grezzo: "それから…。"
en: And then...
en_grezzo: "And then..."
it: E poi...

jp: 調査隊？は…。
jp_grezzo: "調査隊？は…。"
en: The research team - if it could be called that - they were...
en_grezzo: "The research team - if it could be called that - they were..."
it: Il gruppo di... ricerca? loro...

jp: ええと…。
jp_grezzo: "ええと…。"
en: Umm...
it: Ecco...

jp: 怖っ
jp_grezzo: "怖っ"
en: Woah.
en_grezzo: "Woah."
it: Che brividi

jp: たいしたことじゃない
jp_grezzo: "たいしたことじゃない"
en: It's not that big of a deal.
en_grezzo: "It's not that big of a deal."
it: Non è niente di che

jp: すまん。何の話をしてたんだっけ？
jp_grezzo: "すまん。何の話をしてたんだっけ？"
en: Sorry. What were we talking about again?
en_grezzo: "Sorry. What were we talking about again?"
it: Scusa. Di che stavamo parlando?

jp: だったらいいけどさ…。
jp_grezzo: "だったらいいけどさ…。"
en: I can only hope so...
en_grezzo: "I can only hope so..."
it: Magari fosse così...

jp: そうか？重要なことだったと思うんだけどな…。
jp_grezzo: "そうか？重要なことだったと思うんだけどな…。"
en: Really? I think it was something important...
en_grezzo: "Really? I think it was something important..."
it: Dici? Eppure mi pareva una cosa importante...

jp: みんなが無事に戻ってきたらバーの酒で一杯やりたいよ。恐怖は旨い酒を飲んで忘れるに限る。
jp_grezzo: "みんなが無事に戻ってきたらバーの酒で一杯やりたいよ。恐怖は旨い酒を飲んで忘れるに限る。"
en: I'd like to have a drink at the bar once everyone is back safe and sound. Fear can only be washed away with a good drink.
en_grezzo: "I'd like to have a drink at the bar once everyone is back safe and sound. Fear can only be washed away with a good drink."
it: Quando saranno tornati tutti sani e salvi mi voglio fare un bicchiere al bar. La paura si dimentica solo bevendo qualcosa di buono.

jp: おや、旅人かい？…ひとつ頼まれてくれないか。
jp_grezzo: "おや、旅人かい？…ひとつ頼まれてくれないか。"
en: Oh, are you a traveler? ...Can I ask you something?
en_grezzo: "Oh, are you a traveler? ...Can I ask you something?"
it: Oh, un viandante? ...Senti, posso chiederti un favore?

jp: 負傷した俺を置いて、仲間がラスキリスに再調査に行ってしまったんだ。あそこはヤバイ。状況を打開する手がかりを探すとか言っていたけど、もう俺たちでどうにかなるものじゃないことは分かっているんだ。
jp_grezzo: "負傷した俺を置いて、仲間がラスキリスに再調査に行ってしまったんだ。あそこはヤバイ。状況を打開する手がかりを探すとか言っていたけど、もう俺たちでどうにかなるものじゃないことは分かっているんだ。"
en: After I got injured, my buddies went on ahead to Raskilis to check out the place again. That place is in serious trouble. They said they were going to look for ways to fix the situation, but I know that it's no longer something we can handle all by ourselves.
en_grezzo: "After I got injured, my buddies went on ahead to Raskilis to check out the place again. That place is in serious trouble. They said they were going to look for ways to fix the situation, but I know that it's no longer something we can handle all by ourselves."
it: Mi sono ferito, e i compagni mi hanno lasciato qui e sono tornati a Raskilis per un'altra ricerca. Quel posto è pericoloso. Dicevano di cercare un appiglio per rimettere le cose a posto, ma lo so che non è più roba che possiamo sbrogliare da soli.

jp: 隊長はこの事態に焦っている。なんとか説得してみんなを連れ戻してきてくれ…！
jp_grezzo: "隊長はこの事態に焦っている。なんとか説得してみんなを連れ戻してきてくれ…！"
en: The captain is getting anxious with this situation. Please convince him to bring everyone back, somehow...!
en_grezzo: "The captain is getting anxious with this situation. Please convince him to bring everyone back, somehow...!"
it: Il capo si sta agitando per questa storia. Convincilo in qualche modo e riportali tutti indietro...!

jp: 調査隊長の名前はラエスだ。君は強そうだけど、黒い獣にはくれぐれも気をつけてくれ。
jp_grezzo: "調査隊長の名前はラエスだ。君は強そうだけど、黒い獣にはくれぐれも気をつけてくれ。"
en: The survey captain's name is Laes. You seem strong, but watch out for the black beasts.
en_grezzo: "The survey captain's name is Laes. You seem strong, but watch out for the black beasts."
it: Il capo del gruppo si chiama Laes. Sembri forte, ma con le bestie nere sta' attento davvero.

jp: お願いだ…。一部、過激なのもいるけどみんな気のいいやつなんだ。
jp_grezzo: "お願いだ…。一部、過激なのもいるけどみんな気のいいやつなんだ。"
en: Please... There are some radical people in the group, but they're all good-natured fellows at heart.
en_grezzo: "Please... There are some radical people in the group, but they're all good-natured fellows at heart."
it: Ti prego... Qualcuno è un po' esaltato, ma sono tutta brava gente.
